item.title: As Students Turn to ChatGPT for College Searches, AI Visibility Becomes Priority
item.description: As Students Turn to ChatGPT for College Searches, AI Visibility Becomes Priority Johanna Alonso Fri, 02/13/2026 - 03:00 AM Students are using AI tools to decide where to apply to college, pushing institutional leaders to find ways to ensure that AI chatbots include their college in the conversation. item.title: State Higher Ed Officials Do Away With the Term ‘Noncredit’
item.description: State Higher Ed Officials Do Away With the Term ‘Noncredit’ Sara Weissman Fri, 02/13/2026 - 03:00 AM A group of state higher ed leaders are on a mission to get rid of the term. They argue it underplays the value of these programs and shortchanges students. Byline(s) Sara Weissman
